description: [Company & tax] Find out who owns or controls a company: its parent chain, ultimate parent and subsidiaries. Use for KYB, credit or group-exposure checks. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/lei-ownership

name.description: Company name (resolved to the best-matching LEI) if no LEI is given

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.
